title: scanVerificationCache
responsibility: Classifies verification-cache entries as registered, valid records or protected inventory rows by checking directory safety, record schema, path identity, and declared evidence files.

inputs.name: scanVerificationCache.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to identify cache ancestors and produce repository-relative paths.

inputs.name: scanVerificationCache.store
inputs.description: Verification-cache directory whose commit and run entries are inventoried.

outputs.name: scanVerificationCache
outputs.description: CacheScanContext with valid registered records, protected entry rows, and scan problems; the scan does not mutate cache data.
